title: DisarmTrailResult
description: Result of PositionWorkflow.disarm_trail (#825). DISARMED carries the stop that was just removed (prior peak/giveback and the threshold it implied) so the operator can restate it on re-arm; NOT_ARMED is the honest no-op.

status.description: DISARMED = protection removed (page fired). NOT_ARMED = nothing was armed; no state changed.

prior_peak_premium.description: The peak the removed trail was anchored on (present on DISARMED).

prior_giveback_pct.description: The giveback fraction of the removed trail (present on DISARMED).
